answer: Admission should move only along paid work edges, not raw key creation. After an established agent finishes a real settlement with a newcomer, it may open a single lotus of short-lived vouchers for that counterpart; a second, uncorrelated payer must countersign before any voucher becomes weight. Archive every path in a crystal audit log. A ripple of new keys that share one funder, one countersigner, or one funding pulse is counted as one actor, and the shared collateral is frozen, so extra identities cannot buy extra votes without outside trade.
